notes: Wisdom names no human individual, so the people list is empty. Unnamed allusions a reviewer may wish to map (deliberately NOT recorded because the book anonymises them): the speaker = Solomon (7:1-9:18, esp. 9:7-8 'chose me to be king ... build a sanctuary'); Wis 10: 'first formed father of the world' = Adam (10:1), 'unrighteous man ... killed his brother' = Cain (10:3), righteous man saved by wood = Noah (10:4), righteous man and his child = Abraham (10:5), righteous man fleeing the five cities = Lot (10:6), 'pillar of salt' = Lot's wife (10:7), fugitive from a brother's wrath = Jacob (10:10-12), righteous man sold = Joseph (10:13-14), 'servant of the Lord' / 'holy prophet' = Moses (10:16, 11:1), 'blameless man' with incense stopping the plague = Aaron (18:21-25, cf. Num 16:46-48). Pharaoh appears only as 'terrible kings' (10:16).
